On April 14, 2023, Bitrue's Ethereum hot wallet was drained after an attacker obtained unauthorized signing authority, resulting in approximately $23 million stolen across six major token types. The attacker rapidly converted most assets to ETH, laundered funds via Tornado Cash, and Bitrue temporarily suspended withdrawals before restoring operations and committing to compensate affected users. A single-signing-key access compromise enabled the attacker to drain Bitrue's Ethereum hot wallet.
